purpose: Shakti-gated evidence gap register for the six real AssetShakti Phase 1 pilot cases. This register records what is actually evidenced versus what remains required before any positive decision or production certification.
rules: Do not infer title, possession, valuation, encumbrance clearance or bidder eligibility from an auction index.
MISSING and CONTRADICTED evidence remain decision-critical where the applicable gate requires it.
Corrigenda/addenda/process documents must be reconciled before a current positive decision.
Composite packages require component-level provenance and valuation boundaries.
Leasehold interests must retain lease term, transfer/consent conditions and other rights-specific evidence.
